title: Inkor gap: I don't ...
can_do: Inkor gap tuzasiz: I don't work, I don't like, I don't play
why: Inkor gap — ham narsa yoki inkor narsa. Inkor gap tuzishda don't + fe'k shakli ishlatiladi: I don't like — yo'q. Shunday qilib, eng muhim shartlar yodlang: don't bilan fe'k shakli, don't bilan ing iloji bor, ham shunday gap.

rule.title: I don't ... — Present Simple inkor gap

points.text: Ingliz tilida inkor gap: don't + fe'k shakli (ya'ni I don't work, I don't like, I don't play, I don't read, I don't go). Bundan keyin, inkor shakllari: don't talab qiladi: I don't like music — Men musiqani yoqtirmayman. Shunday qilib, hammasi shakllarini o'rganing.

examples.en: I don't like coffee. — Men kofe yoqtirmayman.
examples.uz: I don't like coffee. — Men kofe yoqtirmayman.

examples.en: I don't play football. — Men futbol o'ynamayman.
examples.uz: I don't play football. — Men futbol o'ynamayman.

points.text: Inkor shakllari: I don't + base fe'k shakli. Bundan keyin, inkor shakllari: don't + fe'k shakli. Bundan keyin, shunday qilib gap tuzish kerak.

examples.en: She doesn't like tea — Qiz kofe yoqtirmaydi.
examples.uz: She doesn't like tea — Qiz kofe yoqtirmaydi.

common_errors.wrong: I don't like — don't bilan fe'k shakli
common_errors.right: I don't like — base fe'k shakli bilan: I don't like. Bundan keyin, don't bilan fe'k shakli. Shunday qilib, I don't like.
common_errors.why: Inkor gap tuzishda don't + fe'k shakli talab qiladi: I don't like (emas, I don't liking). Bundan keyin, don't bilan fe'k shakli.

common_errors.wrong: I don't plays — I don't play — don't bilan fe'k shakli
common_errors.right: I don't play — base shakli (plays emas, play)
common_errors.why: I don't plays emas — base fe'k shakli: I don't play. Bundan keyin, don't bilan base shakli.

common_errors.wrong: I don't eating — I don't eat — base shakli
common_errors.right: I don't eat — base shakli (eating emas, eat)
common_errors.why: Inkor gap tuzishda don't + base fe'k shakli: I don't eat. Bundan keyin, don't bilan base shakli.

practice_spec.note: Mashqlarni AI shu spetsifikatsiya bo'yicha yaratadi — tur raqamlari docs/mashqlar.md shkalasi.

items.focus: ingkor gapni tanlash: I don't like yoki I don't likes yoki I don't liking
ingkor gap tuzish: I don't like, She doesn't like, We don't like
xato: I don't plays — base yoki -ing; I don't eating — base yoki fe'k shakli emas
o'z hujjatida 3 ta narsa haqida inkor gap tuzish (bu narsadir 3 ta narsa haqida inkor gap tuzish)

tarjima: «Men kofe yoqtirmayman» — I don't like coffee (emas, I don't likes coffee — emas, I don't liking coffee — emas); «Men futbol o'ynamayman» — I don't play football (yoki I don't plays football — emas)

final.task: O'zingizda qanday narsalar yoqmayotganini 3 ta gap yozing: I don't like..., I don't play..., I don't eat...

skill_task.task: O'quvchi inkor gapni tinglab, don't/deiesn't + fe'k shaklini yozing. Shundan so'ng, shakllarni ishlatib, shunday gap tuzish.
